blocks.text: A DPWH official reiterated that the late former undersecretary Catalina Cabral directly instructed his division to encode names of lawmakers, including former senator Ramon “Bong” Revilla Jr., as project proponents for inclusion in an amended budget proposal submitted to Congress.
